label: Raspberry Pi 5 SBC
description: BCM2712 quad-core Cortex-A76 SBC with a single gigabit Ethernet port fed by the RP1 I/O controller, plus dual-band 2x2 802.11ac Wi-Fi and Bluetooth 5.0.
notes: 1GbE only - the Pi 5 has no 2.5GbE despite many RK3588 competitors having it, and the single RJ45 is fed by the RP1 southbridge rather than the SoC. The standard board carries dual-band 2.4/5 GHz 802.11ac 2x2 and Bluetooth 5.0 (there is no non-wireless Pi 5 SKU), so wlan0 is modelled alongside eth0. USB and microSD are not network interfaces and are not modelled. Catalogued twice until issue #60: devices/raspberrypi/RaspberryPi5.json was the compact-spelling entry, with eth0 only, no radio and no source - that file is deleted. The compact form is the same board, its normalised key raspberrypi|raspberrypi5 is already taken, and adding it again will be refused by the importer and by test/hardware-invariants.test.js.
